newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 1.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 1. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Chairman of the ruling Golkar party Harmoko has asked the election supervisory body to take stern action against violations during the on-going election campaign. Indonesians vote in general elections on May 29.

The Armed Forces have asked the three contestants in the general elections to cease bringing out convoys of vehicles during the election campaign. The government has banned street rallies during the campaign but supporters of the ruling Golkar party and the Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP) have brought out convoys in violation of the government's directive.

President Suharto's youngest son Hutomo Mandala Putra was married to Ardhia Pramesti Regita Cahyani. Hutomo, who heads the widely diversified Humpuss group and was long considered Indonesia's most eligible bachelor, is the last of President Suharto's six children to marry.
Jakarta police have arrested 14 people who had removed the flags of the minority Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) during the election campaign in the capital last week.
